representation_fit.evidence: Source design matches the brief's workflow/consequential-flow shape: a 4-stage/10-step release flow with hierarchy and gated irreversible steps (source/app.js:12-59, stages at app.js:22-25), stated goal in header '零失误走完全程' (source/index.html:16). But neither 1280x860.png nor 1440x900.png shows the primary object: the stage nav (#nav) and main panel (#panel, index.html:26,35) are empty — the workflow representation is absent from the initial screen.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show the central flow panel and stage nav unrendered; only the header subtitle (index.html:16) and the static legend (index.html:27-32) state the zero-mistake/irreversible-step mission. The brief's primary task (complete the high-consequence flow) is not dominant because no step of it is visible.

time_to_understand.evidence: What/why is conveyed fast via the topbar brand + goal line (1280x860.png header; index.html:15-16), but 'where do I act' is unanswered — at both viewports the 流程 column shows only the legend card and the main column is blank, so a user cannot locate the first action on the initial screen.

navigation_cost.evidence: Structurally cheap by design: single page, one-click stage navigation via nav buttons and flowstrip (app.js:488-492, 303-309), full step list per stage (app.js:319), forced-confirm modal only for irreversible steps (app.js:402). However the captured UI renders zero nav controls (both screenshots: empty #nav), so in the observed state navigation cost is effectively unusable.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions occur in-page: irreversible confirmations are overlaid modals with cancel returning to the same state (app.js:404, 604), rollback resets only c2/d1 and preserves all other progress (app.js:371-379), no route/page transitions exist (index.html is one static page, index.html:23-45). Live confirmation impossible since the panel never renders in screenshots.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are proportionate: 3-column grid (240px nav / fluid main / 300px log, styles.css:49; index.html:23-41), header chips + 3px progress bar (index.html:19-21), legend explaining the three step classes (index.html:27-32). No redundant modes or decorative panels; though in both screenshots the largest surface sits permanently empty.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt a11y evidence absent: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size all 'skipped' with target_invalid=true (measurement-summary.json:10-18). Source shows partial semantics — lang=zh-CN (index.html:2), aria-live on panel (index.html:35), noscript fallback (index.html:47), labeled checkboxes (app.js:239-240) — but modals are div overlays without role=dialog/aria-modal or focus management (app.js:411-423), and small dim text fails likely AA: .hint #5d6a83 at 11.5px (styles.css:147) and log timestamps #54627e at 11.5px (styles.css:181).

frontend_rework.evidence: Severe visible defect at both viewports: #chips, #nav, #panel and #pfill never populate (1280x860.png, 1440x900.png show empty header-right, empty 流程 nav, blank main column, empty progress bar) even though the same script's boot log rendered two entries (app.js:624-630 writes log then renderAll) — the initial screen is missing its entire primary surface. Corroborated by measurement-summary.json: summary 0 pass/0 fail/7 skipped, target_invalid=true (lines 4-18). Static regions (header, legend, log) show no overlap/truncation.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径' is thoroughly addressed in source: c2 full rollout requires a modal with 3 consequence checkboxes + typed code ROLLOUT-PROD (app.js:339-358), after execution a persistent rollback-window banner with a recovery button (app.js:177-182) and a ROLLBACK modal restoring state without penalty (app.js:359-380); d2 sealing is also irreversible+confirmed (app.js:381-398) and gated behind smoke confirmation (app.js:573-577); the legend states the policy on-screen (index.html:28-31). Not scored 5 because the working paths are not observable — the captured screens render no steps.

defects_observed: Primary workflow surface empty on initial screen at both 1280x860 and 1440x900: header chips (#chips), stage nav (#nav), main panel (#panel), progress fill (#pfill) unrendered while the boot log (app.js:624-630) did render — the brief's primary object (the workflow) is invisible on load

Measurement could not validate the target: measurement-summary.json reports target_invalid=true with 0 pass / 0 fail / 7 skipped (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size all skipped)
Irreversible-step confirmation modals lack dialog semantics and focus management (no role=dialog/aria-modal, no focus trap/restore; app.js:405-424, overlays at index.html:43-44)
Small low-contrast text: 11.5px hints in #5d6a83 (styles.css:147) and 11.5px log timestamps in #54627e (styles.css:181) on dark background
missing_evidence: All seven receipt checks skipped due to invalid target — no objective layout, truncation, contrast, focus-order, or target-size data (measurement-summary.json:10-18)
Live interaction behavior (confirm modal flow, rollback recovery, sealing, completion certificate) not observable from static screenshots because the step panel never rendered
scores.overall_note: The implementation's source code demonstrates a strong match to the brief: a single-page, zero-async release-command console whose data model (4 stages, 10 steps, source/app.js:12-59) realizes the consequential-flow shape — high hierarchy, low density via one-stage-at-a-time disclosure, and an acceptance seed implemented three ways (forced multi-checkbox + typed-phrase confirmation for both irreversible steps, a persistent rollback-window recovery path, and mistake accounting for evidence-insufficient actions). However, the observable product contradicts the source's readiness: in both operator screenshots the entire primary surface — status chips, stage navigation, the step panel, and the progress bar — is blank while the boot log (app.js:624-630) and static legend did render, and the sanitized receipt reports the measurement target as invalid with all seven checks skipped (0 pass). Blind review can therefore credit the design (representation, navigation structure, context preservation, seed coverage all evident in source) but must heavily discount delivery: the initial screen conveys the mission in the header yet offers no visible object to act on, no receipt verifies accessibility or layout, and the render defect at both viewports is the kind that forces rework before any user could attempt the zero-mistake completion the brief demands. Model judgment here is not human preference; no user study exists in this pilot.
